Select molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name as molecule_name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds in document CHEMBL5241111. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Left join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5241111'. Return the specified columns and sort by molecule ChEMBL ID.
